text: Foundations of the Name
A general's son does not live in his father's tents. Raise new works in our lands and show that the house of Zhu still builds.
Men of Worth
Zhu Jun could take the measure of a man in a single audience. Recruit generals worthy of standing in his hall.
First Test of Arms
The realm whispers that the son is not the father. Win two battles and silence them.
A Proper Command
Your father never marched with a rabble. Field a full host of twenty-one units, drilled and provisioned.
Steward of the Land
Zhu Jun governed as firmly as he fought. Hold three regions in good order.
The Rebels' Due
Your father broke the Yellow Turbans at Wancheng. Break five armies and remind the realm whose blood you carry.
A Governor's Measure
He was made administrator for his victories. Bring two complete provinces under your rule.
The Grand Muster
Match the great musters your father once led. Field sixty-three units - three full hosts - beneath the Zhu banners.
The House Endures
Prove the house of Zhu is no fading memory. Hold six regions.
His Equal in War
Ten victories, and even the old veterans will say the son fights as the father did.
His Equal in Rule
Govern four complete provinces, as capable in peace as in war.
Beyond the Name
Zhu Jun died with the Han in ruins around him. Destroy three of the powers that make war upon you, and do what even he could not.
